description: This file defines a Flutter controller class 'AppSearchController' responsible for managing the search feature in the frontend. It handles user queries, interacts with a content repository to fetch search results, manages recent searches using a cache, and notifies the UI of state changes.

classes.name: AppSearchController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier controller that manages search queries, results, recent searches, and interactions with the content repository and cache.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current search query and clears any previous error message, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Performs a search with the current query, updates results, handles loading state and errors, and manages recent searches.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Re-runs the current search query to refresh results from cache.

methods.name: clearRecent
methods.description: Clears the list of recent searches from cache.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes cache listener and cleans up resources.
